name: prompt-393
image_vibe: Clean Korean street editorial, monochrome black, photorealistic test-shot realism
image_purpose: Create a full-body fashion lookbook/test shot with controlled all-black styling.

prompt.project_info: A full-body photorealistic fashion portrait of an original adult East Asian woman in all-black styling.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult East Asian woman with pale natural skin, refined features, large natural eyes, soft neutral lips, jet-black hair with blunt bangs falling past the chest, and a calm confident controlled posture. Keep realistic proportions and natural skin texture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-body framing from head to shoes, subject centered and filling most of the frame, relaxed arms or slight hip angle, standing tall against an industrial tiled interior or neutral architectural doorway. Offer two outfit variations: fitted long-sleeve black top with structured waist, pleated mini skirt and over-the-knee lace-up platform boots; or black cropped top, black jeans, choker stack and matte boots.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural-feeling light with gentle directional falloff, cool neutral background, deep matte blacks, natural skin tones, and no neon or colored gels.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical fashion test shot, clean realistic perspective without fisheye distortion, sharp face-to-boot detail, realistic fabric, leather, lace, and skin texture, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Generate a full-body photorealistic fashion portrait of an original adult East Asian woman in all-black styling, standing tall with calm confident controlled posture. Give her pale natural skin, refined features, large natural eyes, soft neutral lips, and jet-black hair with blunt bangs falling past the chest. Use a vertical composition from head to shoes, centered against an industrial interior with worn tile and window/metal framing or a neutral architectural doorway. Choose either a fitted long-sleeve black top with structured waist, pleated mini skirt, belt hardware and over-the-knee lace-up platform boots, or a black cropped top, black jeans, choker stack and matte boots. Use soft diffused natural-feeling light, cool neutral background, deep matte blacks, natural skin tones, clean realistic perspective, sharp fashion detail, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent clothing, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, cosplay, fantasy, latex fetish styling, anime, CGI, distorted anatomy, fisheye distortion, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No external reference is required for this text-derived template. Preserve one original adult East Asian woman, jet-black blunt-bang hair, all-black high-fashion styling, full-body test-shot framing, architectural setting, soft natural light, and realistic editorial finish. Select one of the two stated outfit variants consistently; do not add fantasy styling or logos.
